label: Printer

questions.text: How many pages are printed in a month?
questions.why: Heavy printing wears parts faster; very little printing can let ink dry.

questions.text: Does the printer sometimes sit unused for weeks?
questions.why: Ink can dry in the print head when it is not used.

questions.text: Which ink or toner do you use?
questions.why: The wrong ink or toner can block the print head.
Damp, thick or crumpled paper causes jams.

questions.text: Does the power at home often dip, flicker or trip?
questions.why: Unsteady power can damage the electronics.

questions.text: Have you noticed paper jams, faded or streaky prints or error lights?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Switch off and unplug the printer before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning an appliance that is plugged in risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the printer yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Print a page every week or two if the printer sits idle.
care_tips.why: Ink can dry in the print head.

care_tips.text: Use the ink or toner the brand recommends for your model.
care_tips.why: The wrong ink can block the print head.

care_tips.text: Use dry, flat paper of the type your manual lists.
care_tips.why: Damp or crumpled paper jams the rollers.

care_tips.text: Keep the printer covered from dust when not in use.
care_tips.why: Dust affects the rollers and prints.

care_tips.text: Plug it into a surge protector if the power is unsteady.
care_tips.why: Power spikes can damage the board.

care_tips.text: For repeated jams, streaky prints or error lights, follow the manual's checks, then contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: Forcing jammed paper can damage the rollers.

reminders.text: Print a test page so the ink does not dry.
reminders.interval_text: about every 2 weeks if the printer is idle
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.

warranty_structure.note: Covered for a standard period, sometimes limited by the number of pages printed - check your warranty card.
Some brands cover it separately or with conditions - check your warranty card.
Consumables are usually not covered - check your warranty card.

exclusions_to_look_for: Damage from ink or toner that is not genuine
Damage from paper jams caused by the wrong paper
Repairs by people the brand has not authorised
